dict.string: Sync health data directly with your other devices on the same network.
Scan a lab device's code or another device's link code, and photograph lab reports.
Choose photos of lab reports for PhysiMind to read on this device.
PhysiMind reads your steps, heart rate, sleep, body measurements and more from Apple Health and keeps them with your other health data, on this device and your other devices.
PhysiMind adds the body composition measured in the lab (weight, height, BMI, body fat, lean body mass, waist) to Apple Health.
